Crops · dekad 2026-09-01

Australia

2 of 548 crop regions in Australia are at their worst on record for this point in the season. Its highest in any previous year was 49, on a recent average of 12.92.

Vegetation, cumulativethe harvest measure2of 548
Vegetation, current7of 548
Water satisfaction9of 548
Rainfall, 3-month20of 548
Temperature120of 548

What moved, and when

Each square is one dekad, and its shade shows how many of this country’s crop regions stood at their own worst on record for that point in the season. Rows are ordered by how much time each instrument summarises, shortest first, because a shorter window can move sooner. That order is fixed and is the same on every country page.

Vegetation, currentthis dekadalready elevated when this window opens, so nothing here shows when it began
Soil moisturethis dekadalready elevated when this window opens, so nothing here shows when it began
Temperaturethis dekadalready elevated when this window opens, so nothing here shows when it began
Rainfall, 3-monththe past 3 months
Vegetation, cumulativethe season so far, from sowingalready elevated when this window opens, so nothing here shows when it began
Water satisfactionthe season so far, as a water balancealready elevated when this window opens, so nothing here shows when it began

What connects these rows

The driver is water. This section says what moved and when. It never says because.

These 25 dekads were picked rather than derived. A shorter window changes which peak looks like the first, and a sequence visible inside a window may not exist outside it.

How bad is it, against this country’s own record

Five instruments read together our combination, not an observation

22nd worst of 26 years at this point in the season

The 22nd most stressed of 26 observations for this point in the season, 2001-2026, across 5 instruments read together

  • Every input is measured against its own record, but no source publishes this average. It is our combination, not an observation.
  • This value places the country against itself, so it does not rank countries against each other. Its year-to-year spread here is 0.228, and that spread differs by place, so a higher value elsewhere can be a less unusual year than this one. The rank is the comparable figure.
  • A reading of conditions to date. It carries no statement about the rest of the season.

What the instruments say

The canopy is in its best third, as are water satisfaction and rainfall.

Each track is that instrument’s own 26 years, worst on the left.

Five instruments, each against its own 26 years for this point in the season. They are shown together because they can disagree: a region can sit at a record low on vegetation while water or rainfall sits in its best third. 66 of the 440 regions at a record low on current vegetation have water or rainfall sitting in its own best third at the same moment, about one in seven. This page reports where each one sits and does not say what caused what.

Every region of Australia, worst to least

Each bar is the full spread of that region’s previous 25 years at this point in the season. The dot is this year. A dot at the left of a wide bar and a dot at the left of a narrow bar are different findings, which is why the history is drawn rather than described.

Regions in colour are at their worst on record. The rest are placed on the same scale so a single deep region inside an otherwise ordinary country reads differently from a country where the whole distribution has moved.
